stem.text: When 1-methylcyclohexene reacts with $\text{Br}_2$ the product is X.
When 1-methylcyclohexene reacts with HBr the **major** product is Y.

stem.alt: Reaction scheme: a cyclohexene ring with a methyl group on one alkene carbon. A left-pointing arrow labelled Br2 gives product X; a right-pointing arrow labelled HBr gives product Y.

A.text: X is a mixture of two stereoisomers; Y does **not** have stereoisomers.

B.text: X is a mixture of two stereoisomers; Y is a mixture of four stereoisomers.

C.text: X is a mixture of four stereoisomers; Y does **not** have stereoisomers.

D.text: X is a mixture of four stereoisomers; Y is a mixture of four stereoisomers.
